subject: CT Signal: Stamford permitted 15.9% of Connecticut's new housing in 2025

stories.question: Which Connecticut towns permitted the most new housing?
stories.answer_text: Stamford permitted 1,564 new housing units in 2025, leading 169 Connecticut towns (9,834 units permitted statewide).

stories.question: Which Connecticut town has the highest property tax rate?
stories.answer_text: In fiscal year 2027, Hartford taxes real property at 69.95 mills, 2.6 times the 26.65-mill rate that property pays statewide across 169 towns.

stories.question: Where do Connecticut single-family homes sell for the most?
stories.answer_text: Single-family homes in Greenwich sold for a median of $2,850,000 in 2024, the highest of 150 towns with 10 or more sales (statewide median: $426,000).

stories.question: Is Connecticut's job market doing better or worse than the rest of the country?
stories.answer_text: Connecticut's unemployment rate is 5.1% (October 2026), the 2nd-highest of 51 peers.

stories.question: Which Connecticut towns spend the most per public school student?
stories.answer_text: Sharon spent $47,845 per public school student in 2023, the highest of 169 Connecticut towns (statewide median: $20,958).

stories.question: Which Connecticut towns grew their property tax base fastest?
stories.answer_text: Bridgeport added $4.85B of net taxable property in 2025 (+59.9%), the fastest growth of 169 towns.
